system.description: Speak a word and vanish to your sanctuary, taking up to three willing creatures within 10' with you. Name the sanctuary when you learn the spell; you may change it by spending a Downtime activity there.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you may take up to six creatures.
outcomes.success: You and your companions arrive at your sanctuary.
outcomes.ruin: You arrive, but the sanctuary is not as you left it, and something there has noticed you were gone. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
